sv.title: Efter kollapsen: Vd:n rensar kalendern
sv.summary: Forskningsbolaget Cereno Scientific kollapsade i fredags. Nu avgår vd Sten Sörensen som styrelseledamot i forskningsbolaget Synact Pharma för att fokusera på sina operativa ansvarsområden, enligt ett pressmeddelande.

en.title: After the collapse: CEO clears his calendar
en.summary: Research company Cereno Scientific collapsed on Friday. Now CEO Sten Sörensen is stepping down as board member of research company Synact Pharma to focus on his operational responsibilities, according to a press release.
